purpose: All matched read comparisons, including the initial regression and its repeat; no stable all-read latency improvement claimed.

comparisons.workload: Eight native read cases over 20000 input rows plus replacement/deletion, 32 unrelated tables, five measured samples after one warmup per case/process; complete fetch and independent rows verified in timing; implicit read schema checked.
comparisons.timing_scope: Setup excluded; complete fetch and independent value validation included; no concurrent local build/test/database probe.

isolation_guard.method: Local process census before each native process and every 500ms; comparison rejected if Go test/build, compiler or pytest appears.

comparisons.machine_observed: Immediately after all six timed processes completed; no hardware reconfiguration during comparison.
